sources.title: Strategic road network and sustainable development
sources.facts: Explains National Highways engagement in plan-making and decision-taking affecting the strategic road network.
sources.guard: National guidance does not prove a development has acceptable access, capacity or permission.

sources.title: Development affecting trunk roads
sources.facts: Explains procedure where an LPA proposes not to follow a National Highways recommendation.
sources.guard: A recommendation or challenge procedure is not planning permission or highway approval.

sources.title: Street works permit schemes
sources.facts: Updated statutory guidance applies from 10 April 2026 and reflects permit and penalty changes.
sources.guard: Permit-scheme guidance does not prove a permit is granted or works are safely completed.

sources.title: Street works permits for EV chargepoint operators
sources.facts: Explains how EV chargepoint operators can use street-works permits and Street Manager.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove an installation has permission, power capacity or highway acceptance.

sources.title: Street works and road works
sources.facts: Collects coordination, reinstatement, safety and permit-scheme guidance.
sources.guard: A collection does not prove compliance with every applicable code or local condition.

sources.title: Road adoptions under section 38
sources.facts: Explains section 38 adoption criteria, standards, connections, costs and maintenance conditions.
sources.guard: Local guidance does not prove a road will be adopted, constructed or maintained.

sources.title: Section 278 agreement guidance
sources.facts: Sets out developer requirements for modifying existing highway under section 278.
sources.guard: Application guidance does not prove an agreement, bond, design approval or adoption.

sources.title: Creating a new vehicle access
sources.facts: Explains classified-road planning permission and highway approval for dropped kerbs.
sources.guard: General criteria do not prove a specific access is safe, permitted or constructible.
